```python
import narwhals as nw
import polars as pl

# Create sample DataFrame
df = nw.from_dict({
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 300, 250, 350],
    "items": [5, 10, 7, 15, 12, 18]
}, native_namespace=pl)

# Group by store and aggregate
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    nw.col("revenue").sum().alias("revenue_sum"),
    nw.col("items").mean().alias("items_mean")
).sort("store")

print(result)
```
